description: Convert between military (24-hour) time and standard 12-hour AM/PM time, in either direction. Give military_time (for example 1345, 13:45 or 0800) to get the standard time, or hour_12, minute and period to get the military time. Returns the converted time in every common written form, the plain-English name for special times (midnight, noon) and the hour of the military-time chart it sits in. Use military_shift_hours instead to find how many hours run between two military times.

hour_12.description: The hour on a 12-hour clock, 1 to 12. Use with period (and minute).

military_time.description: A military time such as 1345, 13:45, 945 or 2400 (end of day). Give this, or hour_12 with period.

minute.description: The minute, 0 to 59, used with hour_12. Default 0.

period.description: AM or PM, used with hour_12.

name: military_time_convert

calculator_url.description: The TeamPredict calculator page that shows the same calculation, where a person can change the inputs.

inputs.description: The inputs as used, with defaults filled in.

results.description: The computed numbers. Unavailable numbers are null.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences with the headline numbers.

title: Military (24-hour) time converter
